package ent_test

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	"entgo.io/ent/dialect"
	entsql "entgo.io/ent/dialect/sql"
	jsonv2 "entgo.io/ent/entc/gen/testdata/jsonv2/schema"
	_ "github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"jsonv2test/ent"
	"jsonv2test/ent/configured"
	"jsonv2test/ent/record"
)

func TestJSONOptionsV2Defaults(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite3", "file:jsonv2?mode=memory&cache=shared&_fk=1")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	client := ent.NewClient(ent.Driver(entsql.OpenDB(dialect.SQLite, db)))
	defer client.Close()
	require.NoError(t, client.Schema.Create(ctx))
	stored := func(id int, column string) string {
		t.Helper()
		var value string
		require.NoError(t, db.QueryRow("SELECT "+column+" FROM records WHERE id = ?", id).Scan(&value))
		return value
	}
	setRaw := func(id int, column, value string) {
		t.Helper()
		_, err := db.Exec("UPDATE records SET "+column+" = ? WHERE id = ?", []byte(value), id)
		require.NoError(t, err)
	}
	payload := &jsonv2.Payload{Name: "<tag>&"}
	r := client.Record.Create().SetName("first").SetLegacy(payload).SetModern(payload).
		SetDictionary(nil).SetStream(&jsonv2.Stream{Value: "hello"}).SaveX(ctx)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"name":"<tag>&","items":null}`, stored(r.ID, "legacy"))
	require.Equal(t, `{"name":"<tag>&","count":0,"items":[]}`, stored(r.ID, "modern_data"))
	require.Equal(t, `[]`, stored(r.ID, "tags"))
	require.Equal(t, `{}`, stored(r.ID, "dictionary"))
	require.Equal(t, `"v2:hello"`, stored(r.ID, "stream"))
	r = client.Record.GetX(ctx, r.ID)
	require.Nil(t, r.Legacy.Items)
	require.NotNil(t, r.Modern.Items)
	require.NotNil(t, r.Tags)
	require.NotNil(t, r.Dictionary)
	require.Equal(t, "hello", r.Stream.Value)

	// Both update builders, appending to NULL and existing arrays, and clearing.
	r = r.Update().SetModern(&jsonv2.Payload{Name: "updated"}).
		AppendEntries([]jsonv2.Payload{{Name: "a"}}).SaveX(ctx)
	require.JSONEq(t, `[{"name":"a","count":0,"items":[]}]`, stored(r.ID, "entries"))
	client.Record.Update().Where(record.ID(r.ID)).SetModern(&jsonv2.Payload{Name: "many"}).
		AppendEntries([]jsonv2.Payload{{Name: "b"}}).AppendTags([]string{"tag"}).SaveX(ctx)
	r = client.Record.GetX(ctx, r.ID)
	require.Equal(t, "many", r.Modern.Name)
	require.Len(t, r.Entries, 2)
	require.NotNil(t, r.Entries[1].Items)
	require.Equal(t, []string{"tag"}, r.Tags)
	r.Update().ClearModern().SaveX(ctx)
	require.Nil(t, client.Record.GetX(ctx, r.ID).Modern)

	// Case-sensitive matching is selected independently for each column.
	setRaw(r.ID, "legacy", `{"NAME":"legacy"}`)
	setRaw(r.ID, "modern_data", `{"NAME":"modern"}`)
	r = client.Record.GetX(ctx, r.ID)
	require.Equal(t, "legacy", r.Legacy.Name)
	require.Empty(t, r.Modern.Name)
	var projected []struct {
		Legacy *jsonv2.Payload
		Modern *jsonv2.Payload `sql:"modern_data"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, client.Record.Query().Where(record.ID(r.ID)).
		Select(record.FieldLegacy, record.FieldModern).Scan(ctx, &projected))
	require.Equal(t, "legacy", projected[0].Legacy.Name)
	require.Empty(t, projected[0].Modern.Name)
	projected = nil
	require.NoError(t, client.Record.Query().Where(record.ID(r.ID)).
		Select(record.FieldModern, record.FieldLegacy).Scan(ctx, &projected))
	require.Equal(t, "legacy", projected[0].Legacy.Name)
	require.Empty(t, projected[0].Modern.Name)
	projected = nil
	require.NoError(t, client.Record.Query().Where(record.ID(r.ID)).
		GroupBy(record.FieldLegacy, record.FieldModern).Scan(ctx, &projected))
	require.Empty(t, projected[0].Modern.Name)

	// Scalar projections retain their raw database representation.
	raw, err := client.Record.Query().Where(record.ID(r.ID)).Select(record.FieldLegacy).String(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"NAME":"legacy"}`, raw)
	raw, err = client.Record.Query().Where(record.ID(r.ID)).Select(record.FieldModern).String(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, `{"NAME":"modern"}`, raw)

	// An expression with no schema field retains the standalone scanner's
	// compatibility behavior for inferred JSON destinations.
	var expressions []struct {
		Modern *jsonv2.Payload `sql:"modern_data"`
		Extra  *jsonv2.Payload
	}
	require.NoError(t, client.Record.Query().Where(record.ID(r.ID)).Select(record.FieldModern).
		Aggregate(func(s *entsql.Selector) string { return entsql.As(s.C(record.FieldLegacy), "extra") }).
		Scan(ctx, &expressions))
	require.Empty(t, expressions[0].Modern.Name)
	require.Equal(t, "legacy", expressions[0].Extra.Name)

	// Invalid documents and encoding failures propagate through the client.
	for _, raw := range []string{`{"name":"a","name":"b"}`, "{\"name\":\"\xff\"}"} {
		setRaw(r.ID, "modern_data", raw)
		_, err := client.Record.Get(ctx, r.ID)
		require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unmarshal field modern")
	}
	setRaw(r.ID, "modern_data", `null`)
	_, err = client.Record.Create().SetName("invalid").SetModern(&jsonv2.Payload{Name: "\xff"}).Save(ctx)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "marshal value for column modern_data")
	_, err = r.Update().AppendEntries([]jsonv2.Payload{{Name: "\xff"}}).Save(ctx)
	require.Error(t, err)
	_, err = r.Update().SetRaw(json.RawMessage(`{"a":1,"a":2}`)).Save(ctx)
	require.Error(t, err)

	// Bulk creates and upserts reuse the v2 field encoder.
	bulk := client.Record.CreateBulk(
		client.Record.Create().SetName("bulk1").SetModern(payload),
		client.Record.Create().SetName("bulk2").SetModern(payload),
	).SaveX(ctx)
	for _, row := range bulk {
		require.Equal(t, `{"name":"<tag>&","count":0,"items":[]}`, stored(row.ID, "modern_data"))
	}
	require.NoError(t, client.Record.Create().SetName("first").SetModern(payload).
		OnConflictColumns(record.FieldName).UpdateNewValues().Exec(ctx))
	require.Equal(t, `{"name":"<tag>&","count":0,"items":[]}`, stored(r.ID, "modern_data"))
}

func TestJSONOptionsOverrides(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	db, err := sql.Open("sqlite3", "file:jsonv2options?mode=memory&cache=shared&_fk=1")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	client := ent.NewClient(ent.Driver(entsql.OpenDB(dialect.SQLite, db)))
	defer client.Close()
	require.NoError(t, client.Schema.Create(ctx))
	stored := func(id int, column string) string {
		t.Helper()
		var value string
		require.NoError(t, db.QueryRow("SELECT "+column+" FROM configureds WHERE id = ?", id).Scan(&value))
		return value
	}
	r := client.Configured.Create().SetPayload(&jsonv2.Payload{Count: 3}).
		SetOrdered(map[string]int{"z": 1, "a": 2}).SetMixed([]int{1, 2}).
		SetEntries([]jsonv2.Custom{"first"}).SetRaw(json.RawMessage(`{"a":1,"a":2}`)).SaveX(ctx)
	require.Equal(t, `{"name":"","count":"3","items":null}`, stored(r.ID, "payload"))
	require.Equal(t, `{"a":2,"z":1}`, stored(r.ID, "ordered"))
	require.Equal(t, `["1","2"]`, stored(r.ID, "mixed"))
	require.Equal(t, `["custom:first"]`, stored(r.ID, "entries"))
	require.Equal(t, `{"a":1,"a":2}`, stored(r.ID, "raw"))
	r = client.Configured.GetX(ctx, r.ID)
	require.Equal(t, []int{1, 2}, r.Mixed)
	require.Equal(t, 3, r.Payload.Count)
	require.Equal(t, []jsonv2.Custom{"first"}, r.Entries)

	r.Update().AppendEntries([]jsonv2.Custom{"second"}).AppendMixed([]int{3}).SaveX(ctx)
	client.Configured.Update().Where(configured.ID(r.ID)).AppendEntries([]jsonv2.Custom{"third"}).SaveX(ctx)
	require.Equal(t, `["custom:first","custom:second","custom:third"]`, stored(r.ID, "entries"))
	require.Equal(t, `["1","2","3"]`, stored(r.ID, "mixed"))

	_, err = db.Exec("UPDATE configureds SET payload = ?, mixed_legacy = ? WHERE id = ?",
		[]byte(`{"NAME":"first","NAME":"case","count":"4"}`), []byte(`{"NAME":"mixin"}`), r.ID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	r = client.Configured.GetX(ctx, r.ID)
	require.Equal(t, "case", r.Payload.Name)
	require.Equal(t, 4, r.Payload.Count)
	var projected []struct {
		Payload     *jsonv2.Payload
		Entries     []jsonv2.Custom
		MixedLegacy *jsonv2.Payload `sql:"mixed_legacy"`
	}
	require.NoError(t, client.Configured.Query().Where(configured.ID(r.ID)).
		Select(configured.FieldPayload, configured.FieldEntries, configured.FieldMixedLegacy).Scan(ctx, &projected))
	require.Equal(t, "case", projected[0].Payload.Name)
	require.Equal(t, []jsonv2.Custom{"first", "second", "third"}, projected[0].Entries)
	require.Equal(t, "mixin", projected[0].MixedLegacy.Name)

	projected = nil
	require.NoError(t, client.Configured.Query().Where(configured.ID(r.ID)).
		GroupBy(configured.FieldPayload, configured.FieldEntries, configured.FieldMixedLegacy).Scan(ctx, &projected))
	require.Equal(t, 4, projected[0].Payload.Count)
	require.Equal(t, []jsonv2.Custom{"first", "second", "third"}, projected[0].Entries)
	require.Equal(t, "mixin", projected[0].MixedLegacy.Name)

	require.NoError(t, client.Configured.Create().SetID(r.ID).
		OnConflictColumns(configured.FieldID).
		SetPayload(&jsonv2.Payload{Count: 5}).SetEntries([]jsonv2.Custom{"upsert"}).Exec(ctx))
	require.Equal(t, `{"name":"","count":"5","items":null}`, stored(r.ID, "payload"))
	require.Equal(t, `["custom:upsert"]`, stored(r.ID, "entries"))
	err = client.Configured.Create().SetID(r.ID).OnConflictColumns(configured.FieldID).
		SetStrict(&jsonv2.Payload{Name: "\xff"}).Exec(ctx)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "marshal value for column strict")

	_, err = db.Exec("UPDATE configureds SET strict = ? WHERE id = ?", []byte(`{"unknown":1}`), r.ID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = client.Configured.Get(ctx, r.ID)
	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unmarshal field strict")
	var strict []struct{ Strict *jsonv2.Payload }
	require.Error(t, client.Configured.Query().Select(configured.FieldStrict).Scan(ctx, &strict))
}
